name: problem_id
description: Stable citation id for a problem, SP-nn.

aiGuidance.purpose: Stable id by which a problem is cited in issues, plans and conversation. Aligned with muSrs argument/problem_id.
aiGuidance.extraction: Format SP-nn (SP-01, SP-02, ...). Take the next unused number after searching existing problems.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never reuse or renumber an id, even for a withdrawn or superseded problem.
